mandate: C307 — pre-registered costed OOS sweep of the COIN-M inverse multi-asset term-structure carry (Leg A) + cross-sectional funding carry (Leg B) strategy over real common grids (data.binance.vision/data/futures/cm); Leg A: per-asset annualized perp-vs-quarterly basis signal; long cheap / short rich basis trades, dollar-neutral within asset (long quarterly / short perp for cheap basis, short quarterly / long perp for rich basis), shift(1); inverse settlement PnL pnl_coin = notional_usd*(1/entry-1/exit)*signed_weight; Leg B: cross-sectional funding rate signal; long top-K / short bottom-K dollar-neutral gross 1.0, shift(1), real funding cashflow -rate*signed_weight at each native funding boundary; cost grid [[0,0],[5,5],[10,10],[20,20],[40,40]] bps on ALL legs; benchmarks flat and equal-weight B&H-with-costs on same WF windows; train=720/test=168/step=168; 612 total runs (180 Leg A + 432 Leg B); edge rule identical to C285-C306.

leg_a.lookback_window_constraint: LOOKBACKS_A restricted to L <= 1440 because min_periods(L) = max(20, L//3) must fit within train=720 bars; L=2160 (needs 720) is included; L=4320/8640 are degenerate (flat through the whole training set) and excluded rather than passed with a weakened gate.
leg_a.position_rule: per-asset causal basis signal; long cheap/short rich basis trade within asset; +0.25 quarterly / -0.25 perp or reverse; gross 0.5 per active asset; shift(1); hold H
leg_a.pnl_rule: inverse: pnl_coin = notional_usd * (1/entry_price - 1/exit_price) * signed_weight; ret_per_bar = (entry - exit) / exit * weight
leg_a.cost_rule: cost charged on ALL legs (quarterly + perp) at (fee+slip) bps
leg_a.benchmark: equal-weight buy-and-hold of the same legs with the same costs on the same WF windows

leg_b.position_rule: causal cross-sectional rank; long top-K/short bottom-K; +0.5/K long, -0.5/K short; gross 1.0; shift(1); hold H
leg_b.funding_rule: funding_pnl = -funding_rate * signed_weight at each native funding boundary (causal); stale->flat <= 24h + 1 bar
leg_b.staleness_diagnostic: real COIN-M funding archives carry gaps; runner zeroes positions when funding stale

requirements: selected feature score finite (gap/warmup bars -> flat)
no NaN/non-finite perp or quarterly price in the selected leg (Leg A)
no NaN/non-finite perp price in the selected leg (Leg B)
funding staleness <= 24h + 1 bar in the selected leg (Leg B)
cross-section has >= 2K finite assets to rebalance (Leg B)
per-asset fallback trades by signal sign when only 1 asset active (Leg A)
no missing/None/false gate value treated as permissive
block and record reason if diagnostics fail
